MIT licensed, no dependencies. permalink: /chart/types/funnel/ doc_section: Chart Reporting doc_section_url: /chart/ generated_by: scripts/split_showcase.py --- {% capture specimen %} {% endcapture %} {% capture snippet %}{% highlight csharp %}{% raw %} string svg = ChartBuilder.Create() .Title("Sales Pipeline") .Size(600, 440) .XAxis("Stage", "Leads","Qualified","Proposal","Negotiation","Closed") .AsAnimated() .Series(s => s .AddFunnel("Pipeline", new double[] { 5000, 2800, 1400, 620, 310 }, cfg => cfg.Label(dl => dl.Show()))) .RenderToSvg(); {% endraw %}{% endhighlight %}{% endcapture %} {% include chart-type-page.html slug=page.type_slug specimen=specimen snippet=snippet %}
